source.failed_step: Sign and verify APKs and bundle

observation.cause: The signed universal APK passed APK signature, runtime, telemetry and ABI checks, then the explicit release size gate returned exit 1.
observation.qualification_scope: Historical signed package at the recorded main commit and workflow run; not a measurement of the final release candidate.

change.rationale: Preserve the reviewed 230 MiB universal and 180 MiB per-ABI release limits. Retain the existing native stripping and bounded lossless compression before signing, and require a fresh signed package measurement to pass the unchanged size gate.

behavior_coverage: Classifies a sparse fixture with both ABI entries as universal.
Rejects the historical 253,719,782-byte size under the unchanged 230 MiB limit, with exactly 12,547,302 bytes of overage.
Rejects the same fixture when the universal ceiling is one byte below its size.
Asserts that both single-ABI release ceilings remain 180 MiB.
qualification: Run the canonical scoped host validator and release-scope checks.
Require all applicable PR checks on the exact final head.
After merge, require all exact-main workflows and the existing signed joint publisher.
Verify Android 0.9.66.16 build 150 and Gateway 18.1.3 public assets, checksums and attestations against the actual merge commit.
limitations: The historical signed package remains over budget. A synthetic fixture does not establish a current artifact size or device performance.
The superseded 250 MiB proposal is retained only as history; the active universal release gate remains 230 MiB.
No release may be claimed until the normal publisher completes and public readback is verified.

superseded_proposal.reason: Increasing the limit does not reduce the observed package and is not part of the reviewed release contract.

build_150_followup.intent: Complete the remaining Quality playback and tool precheck findings from the build 150 audit and qualify the coordinated release.
